companyDescription: Single-asset biotech, now commercial-stage · ISEMBYLD (apitegromab-mstn) — first and only muscle-targeted treatment for SMA, FDA-approved Sep 11, 2026
priceNote: Live $41.71 (+0.5%) on Oct 26, 2026 — 52-week range $27.07-$61.76. Market cap ~$5.08B. Down ~16% since Sep 29.
summary: REFRESH (prior report Sep 29, 2026). ISEMBYLD (apitegromab) is approved and launching in SMA at $11,659/vial, and the EMA MAA was resubmitted in October. The stock has drifted ~16% lower since Sep 29. Q3 earnings move to Nov 10 (company date; was ~Nov 13) and will carry the first launch metrics. Consensus $70.44 (+69%; clears the gate). Written against the core Base optimism bias of +23.7pp (realized 14d P75 +6.6%, P90 +11.7%). Base +20% assumes a ~1-3 month horizon for early launch data to re-rate the stock. The print is 15 days out, just outside the 14d North Star window. แนะนำ 3-5% ของ portfolio — Speculative.

catalysts.name: Q3 2026 earnings — first ISEMBYLD launch metrics
catalysts.description: Nov 10. First launch read for the first muscle-targeted SMA therapy (approved Sep 2026; priced $11,659/vial).

catalysts.name: EMA MAA resubmitted
catalysts.description: Marketing Authorization Application resubmitted to the EMA in October 2026.

risks: First-quarter launch numbers are usually small and noisy — easy to disappoint.
Payer access and reimbursement for a premium-priced add-on SMA therapy.
Manufacturing scale-up (a past CRL issue) remains a watch item.
EU approval timing after the resubmission.
Competition from established SMA therapies (Spinraza, Evrysdi, Zolgensma).

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed funds at 3.75-4.00% after the surprise Sep 16, 2026 hike (first since 2023). The Oct 27-28 FOMC is priced ~93% hold / ~7% +25bp as of Oct 25 — but hike odds briefly spiked to ~44% after the hot Sep CPI print on Oct 14, so the path stays two-sided.
macroRisk.inflationNote: September CPI +0.6% m/m, 3.7% y/y headline; core +0.3% m/m, 2.6% y/y — both above consensus. Headline re-acceleration keeps a further 2026 hike live.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Newly commercial rare-disease biotech; moderate rate sensitivity, launch execution dominates.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — the Oct 28 FOMC is priced ~93% hold, but September CPI ran hot (3.7% headline) and a further 2026 hike is still live. October's growth/AI-infra selloff was largely a rates trade, so the decision and the dot path matter directly for this name's multiple.

catalystSpot.preRunup: Now that the regulatory binary has resolved, SRRK should behave more like a standard commercial-stage biotech into its next print — modest pre-earnings drift on launch-metrics anticipation

postWin.note: No SRRK-specific commercial-launch print exists yet (this is the first one). Proxied from general small-cap biotech launch-quarter beats and from the muted approval-day reaction itself, which suggests the stock will react to concrete uptake numbers more than headline sentiment.

postLose.note: Rare-disease drug launches that miss uptake expectations in their first reporting quarter typically see sharp de-rates as the market recalibrates peak-sales assumptions; no SRRK-specific precedent exists yet.

spotSizing.reason: 5%. earnings_beat carries no tier-2 penalty (n=42). A first-launch quarter is often messy (partial quarter), so the print can disappoint even if the launch is on track.

th.summary: REFRESH (รายงานก่อน 29 ก.ย. 2026) ISEMBYLD (apitegromab) ได้รับอนุมัติและกำลังเปิดตัวใน SMA ที่ $11,659/vial และยื่น MAA ต่อ EMA ใหม่เดือน ต.ค. หุ้นค่อย ๆ ลง ~16% นับจาก 29 ก.ย. งบ Q3 เลื่อนมาเป็น 10 พ.ย.
